verdict.rationale: The open-source steel-browser README says Steel uses Puppeteer and CDP for full control of Chrome and lets you connect using Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium. That is the core of reusing existing automation code without rewriting it. However, it rests on a single GitHub statement. Missing for 10: first-party docs detailing the CDP/WebSocket connect flow for each library, code examples showing existing scripts pointed at Steel sessions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
